name: difftastic
description_en: a structural diff that understands syntax 🟥🟩
readme_excerpt: Difftastic is a structural diff tool that compares files based on their syntax. For installation instructions, see Installation in the manual. Examples ^ Difftastic understands exactly which pieces of syntax have changed, and can highlight them in context. ^ Difftastic understands when whitespace matters, and when it's just an indentation change. ^ Difftastic is not line-oriented. If you reformat your code and it's now split over multiple lines, difftastic will show you what's actually changed.…
